title: Flexner report reshapes American medicine

tellings.quote: In 1910, with backing from Rockefeller and fellow Titan Andrew Carnegie, the Flexner report was released.

plain: The Flexner report, written by the educator Abraham Flexner and published in 1910 with backing from John D. Rockefeller and Andrew Carnegie, reshaped how medicine was taught and practised in America. Michels tells this in his own narration, in an episode about the drug industry's past. He presents it as the moment when the richest men in the country gained a hand in steering American medicine.
